name: The Porcelain Pagoda of Folding Weather
description: A pagoda made of delicate porcelain that folds and unfolds like origami to catch different weather -- rain channels into blue celadon pools, snow accumulates on white bisque terraces, sunlight focuses through clear glaze prisms, wind plays ceramic chimes.
prompt: A multi-tiered pagoda constructed entirely of fine porcelain in varying glazes. The structure is kinetic -- roof corners fold/unfold like origami to catch weather. Rain mode: blue celadon gutters channel water into reflective pools. Snow mode: white bisque terraces extend to catch drifts. Sun mode: clear glaze prisms deploy, projecting rainbow spectra onto courtyard. Wind mode: delicate ceramic chimes unfurl from eaves. Each tier a different dynasty style (Tang, Song, Ming, Qing glazes). Porcelain translucency glows from within. Surrounding garden has porcelain flowers. Misty mountain background. Exquisite craftsmanship detail, kinetic architecture.
caption: A building that dances with the sky. 🏮🌧️☀️❄️ It folds for rain, unfolds for snow, prisms for sun, chimes for wind. Each glaze a different dynasty's answer to weather. What would your house catch?
